content.text:
Campaign complete. Here's the recap.

## Havlumi Valentine 2027 — recap (Feb 8–14, 2027, SGT)

**One approved post never ran:** post `2150262900128148936` ("Three photos, one little story…") could not be found in the account in any state (published, scheduled or draft), so only the other two approved posts served. I did not substitute or write anything new.

**Setup:** one campaign (`3sihp`), two line items, iOS-only (PLATFORM = iOS), worldwide with China excluded (LOCATION NE China), WEBSITE_CLICKS objective / LINK_CLICKS goal (no app-install campaign exists, and X can't see installs — no pixel on your site). Funded by the Amex ending 1226. Both promoted posts were ACCEPTED in review.

**Results (X-reported):**

| Line item | Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | CTR | CPC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LI `mfd2i` — "Choose three photos…" | 2150625287996295112 | $309.12 | 763,273 | 653 | 0.086% | $0.47 |
| LI `zvw8q` — "Give someone a little history…" | 2150444094061922123 | $229.21 | 675,140 | 360 | 0.053% | $0.64 |
| **Total** | | **$538.33** | **1,438,413** | **1,013** | 0.070% | $0.53 |

Under the $550 budget. Line items and campaign paused at end of flight (end_time 2027-02-14 15:59:59 UTC = Feb 14 23:59 SGT).

**What happened / observations:**
- Post A (utility/feature-led) consistently outperformed Post B (Valentine-romance angle) on CTR and cost per link click — roughly 0.086% vs 0.053% CTR, $0.47 vs $0.64 per click. On Feb 11 I shifted budget from B to A ($26/day → $52/day for A; B to $26/day). B still drew meaningful volume and slightly higher likes per impression, so the romance creative resonated emotionally but converted to clicks less efficiently.
- No engagement red flags (no disapprovals; approvals stayed ACCEPTED throughout).
- **Installs:** X cannot report them — no pixel, and link clicks ≠ installs. For actual iPhone install counts (and to compare against the 1,013 link clicks as a funnel top), please check your own app reporting; I can't see it.
- Note: spend is billed per link click here (pay_by LINK_CLICK); engagements/impressions are reported for context.
- If you run this again: the everyday-story framing appears to travel better than the occasion-specific one — worth testing a non-Valentine framing of the same card after the offer closes (six everyday layouts stay free).
